items.title: CosmicSting Attack & Defense Overview
items.summary: CosmicSting is a critical bug in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows arbitrary file reading and, when chained with another bug, remote code execution. Sansec observes stores getting hacked at a rate of 5 to 30 per hour.

items.title: Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) and several stored XSS and authorization bypass flaws. Exploitation of CVE-2026-71362 requires no authentication and can lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce & Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin resolves 13 vulnerabilities, eight of which are critical, including an unauthenticated, zero-interaction arbitrary code execution flaw via webhooks (CVE-2026-48358, CVSS 10.0). Another critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6) allows attackers to upload unrestricted files to the server.

items.title: Amasty Patches Dozens of Magento Extensions, 2 Critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks these critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution (CVSS 9.3). Attacks were observed in the wild on the same day the patch was shipped.

items.title: Critical Vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution (CVSS 9.8) via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie. This flaw has been actively exploited in the wild to deploy webshells and create administrative accounts.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: PolyShell is a critical flaw (CVSS 9.8) in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images, leading to remote code execution. Mass exploitation was observed, with hundreds of stores compromised within an hour.

items.title: Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read. Adobe recommends applying the patches immediately to reduce risk.
